search_text: published ZDI-12-025 ZDI-CAN-1451 EMC Networker indexd.exe Opcode 0x01 Parsing Remote Code Execution 2012-02-08 CVE-2012-0395 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2012-0395 10.0 ['EMC'] ['NetWorker'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of EMC Networker. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the way the indexd.exe handles rpc calls with opcode 0x1 for program 0x0005F3D9. While processing this message a user supplied string is copied into a fixed size stack buffer.
